responsibility: This file contains selftests for the modern splay-tree utility templates in splay-tree-utils.h. It builds rooted and rootless test trees on obstacks, verifies insertion, lookup through both comparator styles, min/max and predecessor/successor style navigation via splaying, splitting and removal, node comparison, and debug printing, thereby validating the generic splay-tree algorithms rather than defining new runtime services.
same_name_distinction: This file is purely a selftest translation unit for the modern splay-tree utilities, constructing test trees and validating operations. The actual reusable rooted/rootless splay-tree templates live in gcc/splay-tree-utils.h.
